Price asal me hilta kaise hai? 📊

30 lot ka buy market order aaya. 102 pe 10 lot the, kha liye. 103 pe 10, wo bhi khatam. Baaki 104 se mile. Ab sabse sasta bechne wala 104 pe hai, yaani Ask 102 se 104. Kisi ne price dhakela nahi, bas raaste ka maal kha liya gaya.
